hooks.command: command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}" ] || exit 0; diff -q "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/servers/exchek-mcp/package.json" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/package.json" >/dev/null 2>&1 || (mkdir -p "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}" && cp "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/servers/exchek-mcp/package.json" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/package.json" && cp "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/servers/exchek-mcp/package.json" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/package.json.installing" && (cd "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}" && npm install --omit=dev --no-audit --no-fund --prefer-offline) && rm -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/package.json.installing") || rm -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/package.json"; true

command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}" CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_AUDIT_KEY="${user_config.audit_key}" node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/servers/exchek-mcp/lib/audit.mjs" seal >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
